title: nicotiana cavanillesii
intro: Nicotiana cavanillesii, commonly known as the Cuban tobacco or wild tobacco, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nicotiana cavanillesii include its ability to reduce inflammation and pain, as well as its potential to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
